column2: base Thane uses a distinct source kit while awakened Thane remains explicit prototype
all Thane tuning records are finite editable values
Focus supplies 14 percent seeded crit without inheriting blade attack or Brilliance
Execution is never offered before four real critical hits
Execution cast consumes exactly four critical charges; failed gating cannot resolve it
non-critical hits and other heroes do not add Execution charges
Execution has real timed leading hits then an 80 percent plus 15 percent max HP finisher
Execution is interruptible and never damages a replacement when its chosen target dies
Lunge damages one target and adds a finite self-only crit buff
Eviscerate queues seven separate 80 percent random attacks rather than an immediate AoE
random target rolls are gameplay-seeded and exclude dead or banished units at each pulse
Eviscerate prevents incoming damage during windup and channel, then ends immunity
control interrupts Eviscerate, removes immunity and cancels remaining unreleased hits
no clock tick freezes channels, immunity and queued damage
Thane rejects another kit action and its passive cannot be manually cast
actual Lunge action windup accounts for approach distance, not a teleport or remote hit
actual battle AI advances a Lunge toward its live target during windup
cosmetic callbacks never change Thane results or consume seeded rolls
